documents.text: Revolutionary Left Movement (Peru) The Revolutionary Left Movement (in Spanish: "Movimiento de la Izquierda Revolucionaria") was a Marxist group founded in Peru in 1962 by Luis de la Puente Uceda and his group "APRA Rebelde", a splinter group from the APRA which had rallied the government in the 1950s and 1960s. Inspired by the Cuban Revolution and close to a non-aligned position which opposed itself both to the Communist Party of Peru, the Soviet Union and China, the group initiated guerrilla actions against the government in 1965.
